items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: And that's Clement. Clement Camelot. Oh, Clement. He wasn't as heavy then.

ctx.x: And the trombone behind him? Oh, Wendell Eugene. And there's Willie Humphrey. Willie Humphrey. And this is Lizzie. Lizzie. And who's this on trumpet? Talking about Jefferson. Oh yeah, Thomas Jefferson. That's Thomas Jefferson. That was a wild one.
That's Frederick Coleman himself. And who's on bass? And that's Clement. Clement Camelot. Oh, Clement. He wasn't as heavy then.
Couldn't recognize him hardly. He's pretty light weight.
